[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Arts Major in English and Writing Professions with Departmental Honors","groupId":"0e470808-7b7e-4c37-817f-01944d353a00","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

In order to earn the Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in English and Writing Professions with Departmental Honors, students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative grade point average of 3.5 and major/program grade point average of 3.75.


","groupId":"708a7398-9949-42ec-b76d-01944d353a01","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"1119bfaf-fb7c-4fb0-b371-01944d353a01","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include:

","groupId":"df52b642-dc9c-4340-92e8-01944d353a01","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Seminars (2 courses)","groupId":"dff24106-7052-4023-8f90-01944d3862ee","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit.

 2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.  

","groupId":"1058f5e2-6db1-4843-972e-01944d3862ef","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"0932e472-37d5-413e-a564-01944d3862ef","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

2) Students must complete 60 units outside the primary discipline of the first major, regardless of the department who offers the course(s) in that discipline. (This includes general education courses, transfer courses, CPCE/EXTN units, internships, etc.)

","groupId":"e1fd5838-a17d-4c17-8beb-01944d3862ef","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"1c9cc55d-6cc5-482e-8ceb-01944d3862ef","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note:  Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"72c1cb18-96c3-419a-bea5-01944d3862ef","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"d9015c72-76da-448b-8d68-01944d3862ef","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"be496aac-d0ca-47b2-9cc4-01944d3862ef","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"College of the Pacific BA Requirement","groupId":"dc4e1f1b-1e80-43d5-986c-01944d38cc6f","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete one year of college instruction or equivalent training in a language other than English.

Note: Transfer students with sophomore standing are exempt from this requirement.

","groupId":"7a84c105-9591-4939-b857-01944d38cc70","position":13,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"027a3925-fcb4-423a-80ab-01944d3a7e4d","position":14,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) A minimum of 16 units must be completed at Pacific.

2) Students who complete CORE 002 do not need to take ENGL 025.

3) Either ENGL 106 or ENGL 109 can be counted as a “Creative and Professional Writing, Editing, and Publishing” elective if it is NOT already being counted to fulfill one of the “Required Courses.”

4) “Experiential Learning and Individualized Study” electives are optional, not required for the major.

﻿5) Complete at least one elective from each of the sections 3D, 3E,3F, and 3G. The remaining two electives can be completed from any of those four categories or from the Experiential Learning & Individualized Study category i.e. Section 3H.

6)At least three electives must be upper division courses, numbered 100 or above.
